content: Hi! How can I help you organize or share your event photos today?
Hi! I want to share photos from last Friday's school play with other parents, but I want to make sure I'm doing it the right way.

Great idea, the play was such a special event! I recommend creating a folder named 'SchoolPlay_2024-06-14_v1' to easily track versions. Would you like guidance on setting the folder to view-only for privacy?
Yes, please. And should I double-check with parents before sharing photos with kids in them?

Absolutely, a quick message to other parents for consent is always best. Once you've confirmed, upload the photos to the view-only folder and share the link. Here's a template index you can use for easy organization: <template_index_link>.
Thanks! I've uploaded the photos and set the folder to view-only. Here's the link: <school_play_folder_link>.
Perfect! Now, invite parents to browse the folder and select any photos they'd like. I suggest letting them know they can download original files directly from the folder.
Should I sort the photos by scene? Some parents might look for specific moments.
That's thoughtful! Creating subfolders like 'Opening', 'Group Songs', and 'Finale' within the main folder will make browsing easier. You can rename files as 'Scene1_GroupSong_v1.jpg' for clarity.
Done. Files are sorted and renamed. Should I mention anything about metadata or is that too technical?
It's considerate to remind parents that file metadata (like location) is minimal, but if anyone prefers, you can export photos without metadata. Just let them know in your message.
Awesome, I'll include that in my note. Anything else to make this easier for everyone?

You might add a simple 'How to Download' note in the folder, just a quick tip so parents know to click the three dots and select 'Download'. If you update or add more photos, you can create a 'v2' folder to keep things organized.
Great tips. I'll send out the link and instructions now. Really appreciate your help!
My pleasure! Let me know if you need a hand with anything else. Hope everyone enjoys reliving those wonderful moments together.
